{{Infobox auto|type=Consumable|renewable=Yes}}
An '''amnestic''' is an item that makes a [[villager]] forget its profession. Its tooltip reads "Causes a villager to forget who they are". It exists so that villagers can pick up new trades when an update of the pack changes them.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Villager Amnestics reset villager trades, so they can change update-to-update when needed. If you already have a weaponsmith, pop him a little forget-me-not to unlock the new trades.}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is unlocked by picking up [[Estus Ash|Estus ash]] (glowstone dust).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/estus_ash.json}}</ref> Amnestics stack to 64.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/amnestic.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== On a villager ===
An Amnestic is used by right-clicking a villager with it. The pack then finds the villager nearest to a point about 1.5 blocks in front of the player's eyes (normally the one clicked) and:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/amnestic/villager.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/amnestic/give_villager.mcfunction}}</ref><ref name="vc">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/amnestic/villager_consumed.mcfunction}}</ref>
* plays a low-pitched villager sound;
* sets its profession to none, its level to 1 (Novice) and its experience to 0, which removes its trades;
* makes it forget its job site block;
* resets its restock timer;
* clears its [[favorite food]] flag, so it is given a new favorite food.
One Amnestic is used up, unless the player is in Creative mode.

The villager becomes unemployed and can take any profession from a nearby job site block, starting at Novice with the current trade lists.

=== Eating ===
An Amnestic can also be eaten, which takes 1.6 seconds and removes every recipe the player has unlocked, so recipes unlock afresh as items are picked up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/amnestic.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/amnestic/player_consumed.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
The Amnestic is a poisonous potato with its food component removed, so eating it has no other effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/amnestic.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The recipe uses an azure bluet, and the 1.10 release notes call the item "a little forget-me-not".
* The item's model is named <code>amnestic_wrapped</code>.
